about_the_game:
A new tale of crystal — colored by Noriyasu Agematsu (Elements Garden)

This original soundtrack features in-game BGM from the mobile title FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS, produced by Noriyasu Agematsu of Elements Garden, renowned for his work on popular anime and game titles. With its classic yet fantastical and epic sound, the game delicately, beautifully, and powerfully portrays the world of a "new tale of crystals."

Includes 42 tracks: 38 brand-new original compositions, plus 4 arranged versions of iconic FINAL FANTASY tracks, including 'Main Theme'.

Experience the grandeur of the world of FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS with this long-awaited original soundtrack!
